Select compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Define the compound set by joining molecule_hierarchy from parent CHEMBL122 to include the parent and all salts. Join compound_structures to obtain canonical_smiles. Retrieve activity provenance via molecule_dictionary, compound_records, docs, activities, assays, and target_dictionary. Filter for target CHEMBL230 and standard_type IC50 with units nM. Do not limit rows.
